title: Symmetrical di-substituted phenylamino-s-triazine derivatives as anticancer agents: in vitro and in silico approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9968-9984
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08508F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Em Canh Pham, Bich-Ngoc Thi Le, Anh Minh Ngo, Long Binh Vong, Tuyen Ngoc Truong
This study aimed to synthesize symmetrical phenylamino-s-triazine derivatives with one aromatic amine and two hexagonal saturated cyclic amines and evaluate their anticancer activity. The potential derivatives have been investigated in silico.
